require_play_counts.description: Only the literal query value 'true' enables this check. It requires play_count on each returned video post; a real 0 is valid. It does not require ig_play_count or view counts, or counts on photos. If a required play_count is missing or null, the request returns an error without charging credits instead of a paid partial success. With the default false, counts remain best-effort: usable posts are still billable even with missing play counts. Retrying does not guarantee that Instagram will return the missing counts. [Why counts can be missing](https://scrapecreators.com/blog/instagram-play-counts-missing).

GetTiktokTranscriptConfig.description: Transcript (TikTok). Returns one page of provider JSON in data.

language.description: Language of the transcript. 2 letter language code, ie 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'it', 'ja', 'ko', 'zh'
language.title: Language

allow_long_transcription.description: Paid opt-in, enabled only by the literal query value 'true' (allow_long_transcription=true). Defaults to false when omitted; other values do not enable paid mode. By default, successful AI transcription of videos up to 120 seconds (two minutes, inclusive) costs a flat 1 credit per request. Over 120 seconds, videos cannot be AI-transcribed by default. Set allow_long_transcription=true to opt into paid AI with no fixed duration cap: ALL successful AI transcriptions in this mode cost 10 credits per started minute, including short videos: 10 * ceil(duration_seconds / 60). For example, 177 seconds costs 30 credits and an opted-in 60 seconds costs 10 credits. Empty AI results and errors cost 0 credits for AI transcription. This flag does not force AI and does not enable transcription or AI fallback by itself. Keep get_transcript=true or use_ai_as_fallback=true where required by the endpoint. Returned native captions still cost 1 credit on dedicated transcript routes, even for long videos with this flag; on detail routes they leave the base price unchanged. These routes remain synchronous. Allow at least 30 seconds on your client. Paid long transcription can exceed resource limits or timeouts, so successful transcription of long videos is not guaranteed.
allow_long_transcription.title: Allow Long Transcription

use_ai_as_fallback.description: Set to 'true' to use paid AI only when existing captions are unavailable. Defaults to false. By default, successful AI transcription of videos up to 120 seconds (two minutes, inclusive) costs a flat 1 credit per request. Over 120 seconds, videos cannot be AI-transcribed by default. Set allow_long_transcription=true to opt into paid AI with no fixed duration cap: ALL successful AI transcriptions in this mode cost 10 credits per started minute, including short videos: 10 * ceil(duration_seconds / 60). For example, 177 seconds costs 30 credits and an opted-in 60 seconds costs 10 credits. Empty AI results and errors cost 0 credits for AI transcription. These routes remain synchronous. Allow at least 30 seconds on your client. Paid long transcription can exceed resource limits or timeouts, so successful transcription of long videos is not guaranteed.
use_ai_as_fallback.title: Use Ai As Fallback

language.description: Language code, ie 'en', 'es', 'fr' or 'en-US'. Overrides the default track selection unless original_audio=true. If omitted, prefers captions matching the original spoken language when YouTube identifies the original audio. If that metadata is unavailable or ambiguous, prefers an auto-generated caption, otherwise the first caption track. If the requested or identified original language has no matching captions, the transcript will be null and no credits are charged.

original_audio.description: Set to true to return captions only in the original spoken language identified by YouTube. Takes precedence over language. If the original audio cannot be reliably identified or has no matching captions, transcript, transcript_only_text, and language are null and no credits are charged. No extra lookup or credit cost; a returned transcript costs the usual 1 credit. Omit or set to false for the existing default selection.
